common_prerequisites: Approved quantitative limits and uncertainty budget before execution
Article serial/batch, exact drawings/material/firmware and configuration hashes
Named qualified operator and independent witness/assessor; authenticated identity and scope
Calibrated instruments with certificate hashes, units, range and validity throughout run
Approved safe method, restraint/exclusion, abort and rescue plan
Earlier gate dispositions and NCR closure; no simulation or catalogue claim as physical evidence

evidence_policy.authenticator: Caller supplies trusted external signature/identity verifier; absent verifier always holds. Local reviewer text or digest is not authentication.

groups.deliverable: Sized sandwich/rib/stringer and local hardpoint drawings, service joint geometry, exclusive interface BOM and complete equipment mass closure
missing_evaluators_or_external_tests: Qualified hot/aged orthotropic laminate/core/adhesive properties
Full body buckling/fatigue/crash/coupler/peel and insert tests
Complete equipment, joint, mass/CG/inertia and repair drawings

groups.deliverable: Grade-controlled cartridge/coil/steel/phase geometry and converged shared support-thrust force/flux/R/L/loss/thermal maps
missing_evaluators_or_external_tests: Nonlinear 3D finite-array/steel/coil circuit and magnetic stiffness
Demagnetisation, retention, control authority and full-scale force/loss rig correlation

groups.deliverable: Station and located booster cassette/section/bridge/phase/rail-beam interface drawings, grouped converter BOM, normal/thrust reactions and independently available receiving brake
missing_evaluators_or_external_tests: Measured force constants, normal-force coupling, R/L/voltage/current and repeated thermal duty
Concrete anchors, isolation, protection, phase handover and receiving redundancy
Supplier-priced converter/winding configurations and complete station MEP

groups.deliverable: Prestress/rebar/cover/end-block/bearing/anchor schedules, temporary restraint and lifting plans, ground-selected foundations and emergency load paths
missing_evaluators_or_external_tests: Shear/torsion/end-zone/transfer/cracking/creep and moving train-gap interaction
Ground/utility/settlement/water/seismic/wind and anchor capacities
Load-tested bearings, handling points, restraints and serial survey acceptance

groups.deliverable: Power/thermal single-lines, battery/BMS/charger and services duty, independent support reserve, qualified HVAC/cooling hardware
missing_evaluators_or_external_tests: Measured hot-weather HVAC/door duty, repeated charging/ageing and containment
Isolated protection, support-loss reserve, connector and power/thermal tests

groups.deliverable: Versioned support/phase/reservation/complete-consist sensing and independent protection interfaces, fault containment and physical timing tests
missing_evaluators_or_external_tests: Authenticated independent sensing/clearance, common-cause and power-loss tests
Real current/position control and measured MCU/SBC deadlines
System hazards, configuration authentication and independent acceptance

groups.deliverable: Passenger-transfer hubs between independent fixed lines with accessible platform/vertical paths, route egress, assisted evacuation and located recovery provisions; no train-routing switch
missing_evaluators_or_external_tests: All-stop landing/height/wind/fire/obstruction and assisted evacuation tests
Full station structure, access, canopy/services and emergency transfers
Qualified device stowage/deployment mass, anchors, inspection and renewal

groups.deliverable: Instance-bound MBOM/routings, factory/mould/crew/crane/transport plans, depot/terminal/recovery layout, origin/price records and demonstrator acceptance
missing_evaluators_or_external_tests: Configured machines, controlled processes, measured yield/cure/output and supplier offers
Access-qualified terminal/depot and rescue/winch/tow arrangements and recovery exercises
Independent requirements/hazards/site/operator approval and serial material/test evidence

criteria.derivation: Every applicable exact revision must have an agreed verification route
Operator demand and independently accepted degraded-service policy

procedure: Freeze exact drawings/configuration, all applicable requirement texts and revision hashes, explicit urban/suburban stop classes and independent fixed-line transfer topology.
Obtain operator peak demand, service hours, headway, dwell, spares and degraded service requirements. Reconcile route quantities and all life-cycle scope at equal service.

Review hazard register, independent protection domains, residual uncertainty and authority/assessor appointment. No clearance, timing or egress target becomes an approved limit without signed derivation.
protocols.specimen: Controlled six-car configuration, mass and route model; reviewed operator demand, fire/egress and protection basis
protocols.title: Configuration, hazard, route and equal-service baseline

criteria.derivation: Accepted survey and investigation coverage plan
Relative-gap, foundation and route-height uncertainty allocation

procedure: Georeference survey control, route/chord alternatives, station and recovery footprints. Record CRS, date, vertical datum, accuracy and independent check points.

Plan intrusive geotechnical investigations with the geotechnical designer. Log strata, groundwater seasonal range, test methods, laboratory samples and chain of custody; open-map proxies remain estimates.
Locate/verify utilities, road/water/roof/vegetation/adjacent-train obstacles and clear rescue access at every permitted stop position, including between recovery nodes.
Record land/permissions, foundation settlement, flood/scour, seismic/wind and grid studies with responsible local authorities; unresolved coverage blocks selection.
protocols.specimen: Survey control, representative foundation zones, all-stop door/ground envelopes and located utility/grid records
protocols.title: Survey, ground, utilities, water and route-specific landing verification

criteria.derivation: Exact AW3 asymmetric/fault allocation and measurement uncertainty; evaluate approved case mask
Qualified insulation/adhesive/ferrite cooling allowables
Approved thermal and route energy duty allocation

procedure: Measure dimensions, magnetisation axis, batch Br/Hc curves and initial field map; inspect chips/cracks and positive retention. Lock material, winding, cooling and steel B-H revisions.
Calibrate six-axis force/moment transducer, independent displacement, current, voltage, flux and temperature channels. Tare fixture/friction and measure uncertainty/cross-axis coupling.

Within an approved independently restrained envelope, sweep gap, lateral/longitudinal offset, phase, support current, thrust current and temperature in increasing/decreasing order; retain all approach/recede data.
Separate static support from shared-field simultaneous thrust. Measure finite-array edge force, guidance and moments. Never infer zero-speed lift from eddy-current motion.
Measure R(T), small-signal L versus operating bias, electrical input, mechanical output and calorimetric/temperature loss. Repeat zero/current-off controls and before/after field maps.

Derive finite-difference force/stiffness maps with spatial step/uncertainty study. Compare independently measured force methods and simulation; analyse cold reverse-field demagnetisation and hot repeated duty.
protocols.specimen: Serial ferrite/carrier/core/winding module with actual production retention, surface coating and reaction rail
protocols.title: Six-axis magnetic force, loss, R/L and thermal map

criteria.derivation: Approved load-path demand, characteristic statistical basis and environmental factors
Approved fatigue/creep life and gap/door/structural deformation budgets

procedure: Freeze laminate ply/axis/thickness, core, bondline thickness, cure record, surface preparation and repair process. Include process corners and multiple independently fabricated batches.

Agree specimen geometry, statistically justified replicate count, conditioning temperature/humidity/soak to equilibrium and permitted extrapolation before machining. Record moisture mass and thermal history.

Test tension/compression/shear, sandwich bending/core shear, adhesive shear/peel/cleavage, inserts/pull-through and representative door/hardpoint load introduction. Record full force/displacement/strain, failure mode and photographs.
Repeat dry/hot/wet/aged and sustained-load/creep/fatigue spectra representative of Baghdad service. No room-temperature datasheet allowable substitutes for conditioned production data.
Build conservative characteristic allowables with uncertainty and batch scatter; correlate orthotropic model and qualify repair and NDE detection limits independently.
protocols.specimen: Witnessed coupons and subcomponents from actual resin/fibre/core/adhesive batches, production cure and bonded surface process
protocols.title: Hot/wet GFRP, adhesive, inserts and representative joints

criteria.derivation: Qualified measured force map and independent thrust authority allocation
Qualified winding thermal duty and insulation system
Worst no-regeneration complete train stopping and repetition duty

procedure: Validate isolated measurement, earthing, insulation, cooling and independent receiving brake. Freeze bus limits, switching firmware, section identity and physical anchor load paths.
Sweep entry/exit overlap and phase at AW0/AW2/AW3-equivalent force; measure normal-force coupling and complete voltage/current/R/L envelope at hot/weak supply.
Test section handover, short/open/inactive section, missed position, stale phase, stuck output, full DC bus/no regeneration and loss of receiving supply using guarded energy-limited increments.
Execute repeated station and midpoint-booster duty with actual zero/partial overlap, control delays, braking resistor and cooling. Repeat with the independent primary brake channel unavailable.
Retain synchronised power and force data, braking energy balance and independent safe support/capture response. No ideal force source is a hardware force map.
protocols.specimen: Actual converter, finite stator sections, protection, rail mounting and representative vehicle PM/support module
protocols.title: Shared support/thrust, phase handover and repeated braking

criteria.derivation: Delay-robustness/stability and approved physical I/O budget
Hazard-derived safe support/brake/capture time
Approved timing case; zero misses alone is insufficient WCET proof

procedure: Record CPU/board serial, clocks/governor, thermal throttling, OS/kernel/config, scheduling, interrupts, I/O bus wiring and compiled binary hash. Production safety responsibilities remain separately assessed.

Use calibrated external logic analyser/oscilloscope with common timebase to capture physical sensor stimulus, input edge, task start/end, output command, gate/current response and independent protection action.
Run nominal, CPU/memory/network/storage/interrupt stress, hot/throttled and low-voltage conditions. Record complete traces, all deadline misses and run duration/sample count.

Inject stale/bias/disagreement sensors, lost clocks, boot/reset, bus faults, stuck PWM and loss of supervision/protection supplies. Confirm traction inhibit preserves support until the approved capture state.
Use RTLA timerlat/osnoise/hwnoise as supplementary diagnostics. Never substitute scheduler latency or host offline replay for end-to-end sensor-to-actuator timing.
Analyse WCET/latency/jitter, worst tails and uncertainty against delay robustness and unstable-mode growth. A finite test maximum alone is not a proven WCET bound.
protocols.specimen: Exact SBC/MCU revision, boot firmware, kernel, Rust binary, isolated sensors/I/O, power stage and independent protection board
protocols.title: Target SBC/MCU sensor-to-power timing and independent protection

criteria.derivation: Approved complete geometric uncertainty and dynamic gap budget
Qualified force map, capture and controllable travel envelope
Worst qualified safe-stop/hold/capture duty

procedure: Verify G1 magnetic/material evidence, restraint capacity, calibrated ballast and six-axis load distribution before energisation.
Exercise AW0/AW2/AW3, eccentric passenger steps, pitch/roll disturbances and weak/hot modules; record physical gaps independently from onboard sensed gaps.
Inject bounded sensor bias/loss/staleness, failed winding/inverter, bus interruption and protection-power loss. Record current redistribution, thermal saturation, stopping and capture reactions.
Quantify full stiffness/control matrix and dominant flexible modes, force reserve, independent energy reserve and recoverability; report the worst measured gap before/after every fault.
protocols.specimen: Representative flexible underframe and multiple serial modules with independent mechanical capture/restraint
protocols.title: Loaded multi-module support and fault containment

criteria.derivation: Approved structural stage design and measured release strength
Approved durability/structural/rail alignment limits for stage
Qualified connection design and exact gap budget

procedure: Freeze reinforcement/prestress/cover/end-block, bearing/rail-anchor and approved stage load diagrams. Verify strength at transfer/demould/lift, measured prestress force and elongation, curing history and NDE.
Independently engineer lifting points, sling angle/spreader, handling torsion, lateral stability, transport restraint and crane capacity at actual radius including rigging and ground reactions.

Instrument transfer, demould, storage supports, lift, transport acceleration, partial erection and completed connection before releasing temporary restraint. Survey cracks, deflection/twist, slip and bearing movement at each stage.
Apply approved service/ultimate/cyclic test programmes with safe exclusion and fail/abort limits; reconcile creep/shrinkage/prestress loss and end-zone/anchor/shear/torsion models.
Confirm connection seating/positive lock, grout or joint strength, rail alignment adjustment and serial installed survey. Model fit-up does not substitute for stage stability and concrete strength.
protocols.specimen: Full-scale beam or independently justified representative section/end zone using actual concrete, prestress/rebar, inserts, bearings and lifting equipment
protocols.title: Precast transfer, lifting, transport, erection and connection proof

criteria.derivation: Approved dynamic gap and complete uncertainty budget
Approved route energy and temperature budget
Qualified steel/coating/joint/material thermal envelope

procedure: Survey rail/datums and thermal gradients, measured support stiffness and joint steps. Freeze magnet/rail/material/control revisions and independent physical-gap channel.
Increase speed/load only within approved prior-stage limits; include AW3 equivalents, weak magnets, reduced stiffness, geometry imperfections, sand/water/debris and reverse travel.

Record relative gaps, beam bending/twist, rail loss/temperature, support/thrust coupling and capture reactions. Retain failed joint/offset controls and compare independently instrumented model predictions.
Check spatial and temporal convergence of the digital correlation separately from physical uncertainty. A one-dimensional equivalent beam is not full joint/torsion/fatigue validation.
protocols.specimen: Surveyed representative beam, reaction rails, joints, capture interfaces and instrumented restrained moving sled
protocols.title: Sled/guideway moving-gap, joint and loss correlation

criteria.derivation: Qualified hazard-derived safe-stop/support reserve at hot/EOL
Supplier-qualified cell/pack thermal and containment envelope

procedure: Freeze pack chemistry/capacity, SOC window, end-of-life resistance/capacity basis, BMS/protection, containment and charge connector/cooling configuration.
Replay actual urban/suburban run and disconnected dwell profiles with measured Baghdad hot-weather HVAC/door loads, loaded auxiliaries, weak voltage, missed charge and no regeneration.
Measure connected power, charge taper, repeated thermal duty, support/protection reserve and independent safe-stop energy; distinguish live load from energy returned to storage.
Witness approved electrical isolation, overcurrent, fire/containment and safe-fault procedures at an appropriately equipped lab. No destructive test is performed from this software plan.
protocols.specimen: Serial complete-car services/BMS/battery/charger/HVAC and isolated protected-support power domain
protocols.title: Hot/EOL support reserve, services, charging and containment

criteria.derivation: Approved whole-car exact-variant mass ledger including reserve policy
Approved accessible boarding and door safety budget

procedure: Reconcile every installed serial to exclusive EBOM/MBOM, measure tare/ballast, CG/inertias and support distributions independently of budgets.
Conduct independently approved bending/torsion/buckling, coupler/hardpoint, cyclic/fatigue and crashworthiness qualification using controlled test articles and applicable authority requirements.
Measure body modes, boarding thresholds, door forces/interlocks and post-capture level differences. Include repair, glazing, fire/smoke and passenger equipment evidence.
Document strain/displacement/failure observations and NDE with model correlation; a partial frame CAD animation is not structural or crash acceptance.
protocols.specimen: Complete 17 m car with actual equipment/doors/glazing/interior/carriers/couplers and calibrated ballast
protocols.title: Complete vehicle mass/CG/inertia, joints, doors and structural proof

criteria.derivation: Qualified rope assembly including termination, dynamics and approved safety factors
Operator availability and route-blockage requirement
Approved stationary secure-hold specification

procedure: Verify actual route reach, access and independent supply at the worst passive-coast stop, wet/windy/hot cases, qualified rope/termination factors and independently designed anchor/ground support.
Proof and functional-test winch, brake, rope termination, sheaves/guards, coupler load path and retention under approved safe restrictions; establish inspection and discard criteria.
Time fault detection, controlled support, passenger communication, site access, rigging, tow, secured parking and reopening with actual crew/resources. Record setup as well as pulling time.
Test failed mains/primary rescue equipment and unreachable/blocked landing alternatives. A nearby booster is not proof of movement from outside its finite zone.
protocols.specimen: Actual rescue node, rope termination/winch/drum/brake/anchors/hardstand, serial towing interfaces and immobilised loaded vehicle
protocols.title: Full-load immobilisation, winch/tow, access and reopening

criteria.derivation: Rail fire/tenability/operator and independent authority requirement; no aircraft limit imported
Approved inclusive passenger/assistance scenario and safe alternative
Surveyed road/water/roof/utility exclusion and crowd clearance envelope

procedure: Retain the walkway fallback until route-specific alternative approval. Freeze device, door side/height/roll/capture envelope, ground obstruction and fire/smoke tenability cases.

Test anchors/stowage/deployment in a guarded unmanned rig with instrumented dummies before any independently approved participant exercise; qualified rescue supervision and medical/ethical arrangements are prerequisites.

Cover minimum/maximum/intermediate sill heights, wind/dust/heat, constrained landing, blocked exit, failed device, power loss and fire-unavailable doors. Record the actual variable-height outlet and ground stabilisation.
Demonstrate wheelchair/reduced-mobility/child assistance and an independent alternative where the device cannot serve a passenger. Do not assume an attendant is already present in driverless service.

Measure deployment, entry/descent/exit queues, assistance staffing, injury/impact criteria, clear-ground escape and complete train evacuation under approved population scenarios; include rescue access and repack/inspection.
Independent assessor and local authority review all stop-position coverage; manufacturer building/monorail precedent is not system approval.
protocols.specimen: Actual door/frame/anchor/cassette or approved alternative, representative heights, mobility-assistance equipment and surveyed landing obstacles
protocols.title: Full-scale accessible evacuation, chute and route landing demonstration

criteria.derivation: Accepted demand/capacity/protection and dwell model
Operator approved equal-service requirement
Accepted failure/repair definition, duration and confidence basis

procedure: Close earlier gate deviations, measure complete-consist sensing/last-tail clearance, platform/coupler/trainline interactions and independent receiving-brake readiness.
Demonstrate accepted demand/headway, dwell, fleet/spares, concurrent grid loading and services reserve at equal capacity; test unoccupied receiving berth/resource acquisition and full-tail release.
Run hot/EOL/missed-charge, sensor/communications/section faults and blocked-elevated-route recovery; preserve support during traction inhibition and independent emergency stopping.
Record all failure/repair/event times over the approved statistically justified demonstration duration. Include planned/unplanned maintenance, component substitution and repeat tests after changes.
protocols.specimen: Complete six-car train, independently fixed-line stations/terminal/depot/boosters, grid interfaces and trained operating/rescue resources
protocols.title: Six-car equal-capacity route and sustained fault/recovery demonstration

criteria.derivation: Approved full-scope priced BOM/BoQ completeness
Approved factory/mould/crew production and delivery schedule
Approved repeat production quality and economic plan

procedure: Issue dimensioned RFQs tied to exact drawing/material/quantity/process revisions and required inspection; distinguish UK manufacture, UK integration and unconfirmed origin for each input.
Retain signed supplier return, configured machine envelope/power/lead time, tooling, software, import duties/logistics, service and spare terms; target prices are not quotations.
Witness first articles and measured cycle/cure time, labour, yield/scrap/rework, inspection, environmental control and tool life at intended capacity.

Reconcile priced EBOM/MBOM/BoQ and local value addition without counting imported material as local manufacture; bind serial travellers, calibration, NCRs and repair/spares to installed configuration.
protocols.specimen: Configured machine/tool/mould/fixture, actual material inputs and serial first articles with production routings
protocols.title: Supplier origin/price and manufactured first article process qualification

reference_sources.scope: Traceable force calibration and uncertainty, not a magnetic module pass limit
Independent mechanical, thermal and nondestructive composite characterisation; no material allowables imported
Specimen preparation, conditioning, static/cyclic/creep adhesive test practice; actual process and Baghdad conditioning must be qualified
Handling, access, transport, connection and erection planning; highway guidance is not railway load approval
Prefabricated construction-stage and connection planning; project prestress, lifting and soil limits unresolved
IRQ/thread timing and hardware/OS noise diagnostics; application GPIO/sensor-to-power latency requires separate physical capture
Commercial application precedent only; no OpenSourceRail qualification, throughput or height approval
Operator describes onboard chute/descender use under staff instruction after rescue transfer is difficult; no driverless evacuation equivalence
